apps.name: Reading Journey
apps.description: A beautiful book tracker that captures how every story makes you feel. Scan books, log your reading moments with photos and emoji reactions, and watch your reading journey unfold.

apps.name: WhaleSay
apps.description:
WhaleSay is a whimsical human-to-whale translator. Type or speak, and your words are remixed into a dialect-aware sequence of whale tokens in an animated speech bubble, complete with generated whale audio.

Built with Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform for Android and iOS.

apps.name: Should I Go Outside?
apps.description:
SIGO is a weather app that answers one question: should you go outside?

It fetches the forecast for your current location and gives you a Yes, No, or Maybe based on your configured preferences: ideal temperature range, wind tolerance, and rain or snow thresholds.

Built with Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform for Android, iOS, and Desktop.

apps.name: Toebeans
apps.description:
Toebeans is a cross-platform fortune-telling app for cats, built with Kotlin Multiplatform for iOS and Android.

It combines playful product design with serious mobile engineering, featuring tarot draws, daily horoscopes, and a gamified in-app currency system powered by shared business logic across platforms.

Currently in beta.
